findings.evidence: The revision did not freeze the exact macOS/Linux advisory-lock primitive or prevent fork-inherited descriptors and registry state from affecting the parent call-span lock.
findings.required_change: Freeze platform lock semantics and define PID-bound handles plus at-fork poisoning and reinitialization.
findings.verification: Thread, process, fork, child-unlock/exit, exec, crash, lock-order and inode-replacement tests preserve exclusivity.

findings.evidence: Activation could split coordination between the old and candidate repository maintenance-lock domains after the active-manifest switch.
findings.required_change: Use one installation-scoped activation lock and bind command admission to it and the active-manifest generation.
findings.verification: Concurrent migration, command-versus-switch, crash, rollback and stale-generation tests admit one activation authority.
